units.source_text: 明石道人对公子说：“我乃遁世之身，今日不能远送了！”

en.t: The Akashi lay priest said to the young lord, "I am a man who has withdrawn from the world, so today I cannot escort you far."

units.source_text: 那愁眉苦脸的样子，十分可怜。

en.t: His sorrowful, troubled expression was deeply pitiful.

units.source_text: 那些年轻女子看了他的脸，都抿着嘴窃笑。

en.t: When the young women saw his face, they all pressed their lips together and laughed secretly.
